quiz.q: An Operator-level user finds a PID tuning field read-only. Correct action?
o: Log in with a shared Engineer account
Edit a script to bypass security
Ask an Engineer-level user to change it under change control
Reboot the HMI until it unlocks
quiz.r: Review security levels. Never share credentials.

quiz.q: Pump P-101 faceplate shows CASCADE. What does that mean?
o: The operator drives the output directly
The pump is out of service
The setpoint comes from another controller
quiz.r: Review faceplate modes AUTO, MANUAL, CASCADE, OUT OF SERVICE.

quiz.q: You enter 120% for a speed setpoint with clamp limits of 20-95%. What should happen?
o: The value is rejected or clamped and you re-enter within limits

quiz.q: The P-101 interlock lamp is red. Before switching to MANUAL you should:
o: Identify the active interlock and confirm it is safe to proceed
Switch to MANUAL to override it

quiz.q: Why does the HMI use red sparingly and grey or green for normal states?
o: Grey is the ISA alarm colour
So abnormal conditions stand out (situational awareness)

modules.title: Alarm Management, Priority Filtering, Acknowledgement & Shelving (ISA-18.2)
objectives: Use alarm states UNACK_ALM, ACK_ALM and UNACK_RTN
Shelve nuisance alarms with a timed reason
checklist: Filter the alarm summary by priority
Acknowledge a single alarm
Identify UNACK_ALM versus UNACK_RTN
Shelve a chattering alarm with duration and reason
Review shelved alarms at shift handover
modules.warning: Never shelve a P1 Critical alarm to silence it. Shelving needs a recorded reason and a time limit.
keys: UNACK_RTN: returned to normal, not acknowledged

quiz.q: A new alarm flashes red with state UNACK_ALM. What does it mean?
Which priority is Critical and shown in red under the site alarm philosophy?
LT-205 chatters 40 times an hour from a noisy transmitter. Best action?
o: Shelve it indefinitely without a reason
Shelve it with a timed duration and reason, and raise a maintenance request
Change its priority to P4 yourself
quiz.r: Review shelving rules and nuisance alarm escalation.

quiz.q: An alarm returns to normal before you acknowledge it. Its state is:
60 alarms arrive in 10 minutes after a trip. First priority?
o: Handle P1 and P2 alarms first using the priority filter
Acknowledge all in bulk without reading

o: Ping the PLC and check OI Server connection status in SMC
quiz.r: Review triage order: physical, network, driver, tags.

quiz.q: Which port does Modbus TCP normally use?
Which port does OPC UA commonly use?
A tag shows Uncertain quality. Meaning?
o: The value may be stale or degraded; verify before using it

quiz.q: The PLC heartbeat stops incrementing but ping works. Likely cause?
o: PLC program or CPU stalled; escalate to the controls engineer

o: Check completion daily and test restores periodically per the PM plan

quiz.q: Before patching a production SCADA server you must:
o: Take a verified backup and get a maintenance window approved

quiz.q: First step when a script fails at runtime?
o: Read the error in SMC Log Viewer for script name and line

quiz.q: The historian disk is 92% full. Best action?
o: Escalate to extend storage or archive per the retention plan

quiz.q: UPS battery test shows runtime far below spec. Action?
o: Plug servers straight into the wall
Log it and raise a replacement work order

quiz.q: What does an ESD cause and effect matrix show?

o: Whether the SQL Server Agent job ran and its history for errors

quiz.q: Why must a totalizer reset be recorded?
o: It alters production figures, so who, when and why must be logged

quiz.q: A flow totalizer rolled over at its maximum. Correct handling?
o: Note the rollover and verify against the meter reading

quiz.q: A report job is stuck Running for hours. Safe action?
o: Check blocking sessions, then stop and restart the job per SOP

quiz.q: Report totals differ from the HMI trend. Likely first cause?
o: Different retrieval mode or time boundary
quiz.r: Review retrieval modes and shift boundaries.

modules.title: OT Cybersecurity, Access Control & USB/Network Hygiene (IEC 62443)
objectives: Keep unauthorised USB media off HMI nodes
checklist: Lock the screen when leaving the console
Use only your own account
Refuse unapproved USB media
Know the DMZ and firewall boundary
Report unknown devices at once
modules.warning: Never connect unapproved USB drives to any SCADA node.

quiz.q: A contractor offers to plug a USB stick into the HMI. Response?
o: Allow it if the stick looks new
Decline and use the approved transfer process

quiz.q: Why is auto-logoff enforced on HMI nodes?
o: It stops use of an unattended session

quiz.q: In IEC 62443, what is the role of the DMZ?
o: A controlled buffer between IT and control networks

quiz.q: You see an unknown device on the SCADA network. Action?
o: Do not touch it; report to the security contact and engineer

quiz.q: Why are shared operator accounts discouraged?
o: Audit logs cannot show who performed an action

modules.title: SCADA Redundancy, Failover & Disaster Recovery Procedures
modules.desc: Read Primary and Standby server status
objectives: Read Primary and Standby server status
checklist: Check Primary and Standby state in SMC
Confirm heartbeat between servers
Run a manual failover in an approved window
Reset a frozen thin client RDP session
Verify alarms, quality and history after failover
modules.warning: Run failover tests only with the process stable and the supervisor informed.

quiz.q: Which node normally runs the application objects?
The Primary server fails. What should happen?
o: The Standby takes over; confirm in SMC that it is Active

quiz.q: When should a manual failover test be done?
o: In an approved window with a stable process and supervisor informed

quiz.q: A thin-client HMI session is frozen. Safe first step?
o: Disconnect or reset that RDP session and reconnect

quiz.q: After a failover, what must be checked?
o: Alarms, tag quality and historian storage on the new Active node

o: The SCADA Engineer, using the checklist

quiz.q: What score earns certification?
A P1 alarm appears during the practical. What comes first?
o: Acknowledge, then check the process and follow the SOP

quiz.q: An operator fails comms diagnosis in the practical. Outcome?
